name: Malenky T-Shirt Skullsplitter
description:
"Inspired" by classic military designs with CBD's own twist, the Malenky t-shirt features collar accents on both sides, a rear quarter-zip, and is made out of premium recycled materials to ensure just the right fit.

The gray and red Skullsplitter version showcases a red Vanduul skull shattered by a bloody streak.
